{{Quote|Yah, I know BoShek. That son of a bantha has more warrants for his arrest than I got fur on my face.|Clyngunn to an Imperial Security Bureau interviewer|<ref name="Underworld">{{InsiderCite|89|Underworld: A Galaxy of Scum and Villainy}}</ref>}}
"'''Son of a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]]'''," or sometimes "'''son-of-a-bantha'''," was a disparaging phrase used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], serving both as an exclamation and an insult.

==History==
{{Quote|Son-of-a-bantha, who dealt this mess?|Zan Yant playing sabacc|<ref name="Battle Surgeons">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>}}

[[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Doctor/Legends|surgeon]] [[Zan Yant]] exclaimed the phrase "son-of-a-bantha" in frustration when dealt a poor hand in [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].<ref name="Battle Surgeons" /> 

Writer [[Keets Freely]] referred to [[Bog Divinian]] as a "son of a bantha."<ref name="A Tangled Web">''[[The Last of the Jedi: A Tangled Web]]''</ref> 

[[Imperial gunner/Legends|Imperial gunner]] [[Tenn Graneet]] mentally exclaimed "son of a bantha" when coming face to face with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> 

[[Aminni]] exclaimed "son of a ''bantha''" upon discovering that her [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] had been stolen from [[Gender/Legends|her]].<ref name="Honor Among Thieves">''[[Honor Among Thieves]]''</ref>

During an interview with the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] regarding fellow [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[BoShek/Legends|Boshek]], the [[ZeHethbra]] named [[Clyngunn]] remarked that "that son of a bantha" had more arrest warrants than Clyngunn had [[Hair/Legends|fur]] on his face.<ref name="Underworld" />

==Behind the scenes==
"Son of a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]]"<ref name="A Tangled Web" /> and "son-of-a-bantha"<ref name="Battle Surgeons" /> are similar to the real-world vulgar slang phrase "son of a bitch" and the variant "son-of-a-bitch."<ref name="Son of a">{{WebCite|url=https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/son-of-a-bitch|text=son of a bitch|quote=''vulgar slang'' • '''1.''' a contemptible or thoroughly disagreeable person; scoundrel '''2.''' a disagreeable matter; a chore '''3.''' (used as an exclamation of impatience, irritation, astonishment, etc.) • Also: son-of-a-bitch|work=[[Wikipedia:Collins English Dictionary|''Collins English Dictionary'']]|archiveurl=https://archive.is/ZuHS2}}</ref> The idiom "son of a bitch" also exists in [[Star Wars Legends|Legends continuity]].<ref name="Tyrant's Test">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref> Similar phrases from Legends include "son-of-a-[[Kath hound/Legends|kath-hound]],"<ref name="Path of Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> "son of a [[monkey-lizard]],"<ref name="The Dangerous Games">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref> "son-of-a-[[Mynock/Legends|mynock]],"<ref name="ThonBoka">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Starcave of ThonBoka]]''</ref> "son of a [[rancor]],"<ref name="Side Trip">"[[Side Trip]]"</ref> "son of a [[Exogorth/Legends|space slug]],"<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> and "[[son of a murglak]]."<ref name="Legacy 2">[[Legacy (2006) 2|''Legacy'' (2006) 2]]</ref>
